custom_values.company_name: Business name, e.g. Greater Sydney Landscapes
custom_values.owner_first_name: First name of the person who calls customers back, e.g. Daniel

calendar.subject: Quote call booked – {{contact.name}} – {{appointment.start_time}}

calendar.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, your quote call with {{custom_values.owner_first_name}} from {{custom_values.company_name}} is booked for {{appointment.start_time}}. {{custom_values.owner_first_name}} will call you on {{contact.phone}}. Need to change it? Just reply here.

calendar.subject: Your quote call with {{custom_values.company_name}} is booked
calendar.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Thanks for getting in touch. Your quote call with {{custom_values.owner_first_name}} is booked for {{appointment.start_time}}. {{custom_values.owner_first_name}} will call you on {{contact.phone}}.

If you have photos of the job, reply to this email with them attached and {{custom_values.owner_first_name}} will take a look before the call.

Need to change the time? Reply to this email or call {{custom_values.company_phone}}.

Thanks,
{{custom_values.company_name}}

calendar.subject: Quote call in 15 min – {{contact.name}} – {{contact.phone}}

calendar.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, just a reminder {{custom_values.owner_first_name}} from {{custom_values.company_name}} will call you at {{appointment.start_time}} about your quote.

calendar.subject: Reminder: {{custom_values.owner_first_name}} will call you soon
calendar.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Just a reminder that {{custom_values.owner_first_name}} from {{custom_values.company_name}} will call you at {{appointment.start_time}} about your quote, on {{contact.phone}}.

Thanks,
{{custom_values.company_name}}

calendar.subject: Quote call cancelled – {{contact.name}}

calendar.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, your quote call with {{custom_values.owner_first_name}} from {{custom_values.company_name}} on {{appointment.start_time}} has been cancelled. Reply here if you'd like a new time.

calendar.subject: Your quote call has been cancelled
calendar.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Your quote call with {{custom_values.owner_first_name}} on {{appointment.start_time}} has been cancelled.

If you'd still like a quote, reply to this email or call {{custom_values.company_phone}} and we'll find a new time.

Thanks,
{{custom_values.company_name}}

calendar.subject: Quote call moved – {{contact.name}} – {{appointment.start_time}}

calendar.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, your quote call with {{custom_values.owner_first_name}} from {{custom_values.company_name}} has moved to {{appointment.start_time}}. {{custom_values.owner_first_name}} will call you on {{contact.phone}}.

calendar.subject: Your quote call has a new time
calendar.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Your quote call with {{custom_values.owner_first_name}} has moved to {{appointment.start_time}}. {{custom_values.owner_first_name}} will call you on {{contact.phone}}.

Need a different time? Reply to this email or call {{custom_values.company_phone}}.

Thanks,
{{custom_values.company_name}}
